parameters.help_en: The ID of the model operator service to be released. You can obtain the ID by calling ListModelOperatorServices. The service must belong to the current account and the requested region
parameters.help_zh: 待释放的模型算子服务 ID。可通过 ListModelOperatorServices 获取；必须属于当前账号及请求地域
parameters.name: service_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次请求

ServiceId.description_en: The ID of the model operator service for which the release is accepted. The return of this field does not indicate that the cleanup of underlying resources is complete
ServiceId.description_zh: 已受理释放的模型算子服务 ID。返回此字段不表示底层资源清理已经完成
